UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile document containing PII (email) and personal workspace preferences. Strictly owner-only read and write. Contains zero admin or privilege fields.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: User email address (PII isolated to owner).

photoURL.description: Optional avatar photo URL (0 to 500 characters).

roleTitle.description: Optional professional title or role (0 to 80 characters).

bio.description: Optional short biography or design focus note (0 to 400 characters).

reducedMotion.description: Whether reduced motion mode is preferred across interactive specimens.

recentlyViewedSlugs.description: Bounded list of up to 25 recently viewed resource slugs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of account profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update.

UserBookmark.title: UserBookmark
UserBookmark.description: Saved encyclopedia resource bookmark stored under /users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId} where bookmarkId equals resourceSlug to prevent duplicates.

uid.description: Immutable owner UID matching the parent userId.

resourceSlug.description: Canonical encyclopedia resource slug matching bookmarkId.

resourceTitle.description: Snapshot title of the saved encyclopedia resource.

categorySlug.description: Primary taxonomy category slug of the resource.

notes.description: Optional user study notes for this saved resource (0 to 400 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the resource was bookmarked.

PersonalCollection.title: PersonalCollection
PersonalCollection.description: Custom curated collection of encyclopedia resources created by a user, supporting private or public visibility and ordered resource slugs.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the collection creator.

ownerName.description: Public display name of the collection owner.

visibility.description: Access visibility mode for the collection.

resourceSlugs.description: Ordered array of encyclopedia resource slugs (0 to 50 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the collection was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the collection was last modified.

CollectionItemDoc.title: CollectionItemDoc
CollectionItemDoc.description: Normalized collection item record stored under /collections/{collectionId}/items/{itemId} for scalable large collections.

ownerId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent collection owner.

resourceTitle.description: Denormalized resource title for fast rendering.

notes.description: Curator annotation for this item (0 to 500 characters).

visibility.description: Mirrors parent collection visibility for secure query evaluation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when added to collection.

PlaygroundExperiment.title: PlaygroundExperiment
PlaygroundExperiment.description: User-saved interactive playground experiment with strict source code size limits, template metadata, and private/public visibility.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the experiment creator.

ownerName.description: Display name of the experiment author.

description.description: Experiment summary or implementation note (0 to 600 characters).

associatedResourceSlug.description: Optional canonical encyclopedia resource slug associated with this experiment.

activeFile.description: Default active source file path in the editor (1 to 80 characters).

codeHtml.description: HTML or SVG markup source buffer (0 to 25000 characters).

codeCss.description: CSS stylesheet source buffer (0 to 25000 characters).

codeJs.description: JavaScript or TypeScript/React source buffer (0 to 25000 characters).

visibility.description: Whether the saved experiment is private to the owner or publicly inspectable.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the experiment was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the experiment was last updated.

AdminRoleAssignment.title: AdminRoleAssignment
AdminRoleAssignment.description: Backend-verified administrative role record stored at /admin_roles/{userId}. Writable strictly by a Super Administrator.

uid.description: Target Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrative user.

displayName.description: Display name of the administrative user (1 to 80 characters).

assignedByUid.description: UID of the Super Administrator who granted or updated this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the role was first assigned.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the role was last modified.

CmsResourceDoc.title: CmsResourceDoc
CmsResourceDoc.description: Structured encyclopedia resource managed via the Content Management System with 8 field groups, live preview validation state, schema versioning, and revision history.

slug.description: Unique kebab-case resource slug matching the document ID.

shortDescription.description: Compact summary for directory cards (10 to 300 characters).

resourceType.description: Resource classification (e.g., UI Component, Interaction Pattern, Motion & Animation).

subcategories.description: Nested subcategory path labels (up to 15 items).

tags.description: Search and taxonomy tags (up to 25 items).

aliases.description: Alternative names and synonyms for search (up to 15 items).

previewType.description: Execution template for the live interactive specimen.

codeHtml.description: HTML or SVG markup buffer for the runnable preview (0 to 25000 characters).

codeCss.description: CSS stylesheet buffer for the runnable preview (0 to 25000 characters).

codeJs.description: JavaScript or React TSX buffer for the runnable preview (0 to 25000 characters).

previewVerified.description: Whether the live preview passed the 7-point preview validation gate.

howItWorks.description: Architectural and mechanical explanation (0 to 4000 characters).

useCases.description: Primary purpose and real-world use cases (0 to 3000 characters).

advantages.description: Architectural and UX advantages (0 to 3000 characters).

limitations.description: Tradeoffs and technical limitations (0 to 3000 characters).

bestPractices.description: Production engineering best practices (0 to 3000 characters).

commonMistakes.description: Anti-patterns and common implementation mistakes (0 to 3000 characters).

referenceImageUrl.description: Visual reference diagram or specimen image URL (0 to 500 characters).

referenceCaption.description: Caption explaining the visual reference (0 to 400 characters).

referenceAttribution.description: Visual source credit and attribution (0 to 400 characters).

framework.description: Primary implementation language and framework (0 to 120 characters).

dependenciesList.description: Required packages or runtime dependencies (up to 15 items).

installInstructions.description: Installation and setup commands (0 to 2000 characters).

desktopBehavior.description: Desktop pointer and large-viewport behavior specification (0 to 1500 characters).

tabletBehavior.description: Tablet hybrid touch/pointer behavior specification (0 to 1500 characters).

mobileBehavior.description: Mobile touch and compact-viewport behavior specification (0 to 1500 characters).

browserSupport.description: Cross-browser compatibility matrix notes (0 to 1000 characters).

accessibilityNotes.description: WCAG compliance, ARIA, and keyboard navigation requirements (0 to 2000 characters).

performanceNotes.description: Frame budget, compositor thread, and memory notes (0 to 1500 characters).

editableControlsSpec.description: Parameter control definitions, default values, and reset behavior (0 to 3000 characters).

relatedResources.description: Slugs of related encyclopedia resources (up to 15 items).

prerequisites.description: Prerequisite concepts or resource slugs (up to 15 items).

alternatives.description: Alternative patterns or competing approaches (up to 15 items).

relatedTechnologies.description: Related web standards, APIs, and libraries (up to 15 items).

authorUid.description: UID of the resource author or editor.

authorName.description: Display name of the author or editor.

reviewerName.description: Display name of the assigned reviewer or approver.

reviewNotes.description: Editorial review feedback or rejection reason (0 to 1500 characters).

license.description: Content and code specimen license attribution (0 to 160 characters).

sources.description: Authoritative specification citations and references (0 to 1500 characters).

publishedAtIso.description: ISO date string when published (0 to 40 characters).

lastVerifiedIso.description: ISO date string when technical accuracy was last verified (0 to 40 characters).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent revision.

CmsCategoryDoc.title: CmsCategoryDoc
CmsCategoryDoc.description: Taxonomy category managed via the CMS supporting nested subcategory hierarchies, ordering, featured badge, and merge/archive migration.

slug.description: Canonical kebab-case category slug matching the document ID.

architecturalScope.description: Detailed architectural scope description (0 to 1500 characters).

iconName.description: Lucide icon identifier for visual taxonomy identity.

orderIndex.description: Numeric sort order across primary categories.

isFeatured.description: Whether this category is featured in discovery hubs.

subcategories.description: Nested subcategory paths (e.g. 'Motion > Physics > Springs', up to 30 items).

mergedIntoSlug.description: Target category slug if this category was merged/reassigned.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the administrator who last updated this category.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created in CMS.

CmsSubcategoryDoc.title: CmsSubcategoryDoc
CmsSubcategoryDoc.description: Hierarchical subcategory record stored in /cms_subcategories/{subcategoryId} supporting unlimited nesting depth and parent category linkage.

parentSubcategoryId.description: Optional parent subcategory ID for depth >= 3 nodes.

updatedByUid.description: UID of administrator who updated this node.

CmsResourceRevisionDoc.title: CmsResourceRevisionDoc
CmsResourceRevisionDoc.description: Immutable revision snapshot stored in /cms_resource_revisions/{revisionId} tracking schema version, content provenance, and editorial history.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the resource payload (e.g. 2).

dataOrigin.description: Distinguishes initial sample seed data from verified editorial content.

changeSummary.description: Editorial summary of changes in this revision (1 to 500 characters).

snapshotJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of the resource state (up to 60000 characters).

authorUid.description: UID of the author/editor who committed this revision.

CmsResourceExampleDoc.title: CmsResourceExampleDoc
CmsResourceExampleDoc.description: Runnable demonstration example record stored in /cms_resource_examples/{exampleId}.

isPublic.description: True when parent resource is published.

CmsImplementationVariantDoc.title: CmsImplementationVariantDoc
CmsImplementationVariantDoc.description: Framework or language implementation variant stored in /cms_implementation_variants/{variantId}.

framework.description: Target framework (e.g. React 19, Vanilla Web, CSS Houdini).

language.description: Implementation language (e.g. tsx, css, html, js).

isPublic.description: True when parent resource is published.

CmsPreviewConfigDoc.title: CmsPreviewConfigDoc
CmsPreviewConfigDoc.description: Normalized preview configuration record stored in /cms_preview_configs/{configId}.

configId.description: Stable preview configuration ID matching resourceSlug.

reducedMotionDefault.description: Whether reduced-motion mode is active by default.

controlsSchemaJson.description: Serialized parameter control schema specification (0 to 5000 characters).

isPublic.description: True when parent resource is published.

CmsTechnologyDoc.title: CmsTechnologyDoc
CmsTechnologyDoc.description: Normalized technology reference record stored in /cms_technologies/{techSlug}.

category.description: Technology domain (e.g. Web Standard, UI Framework, Graphics Engine).

CmsTagDoc.title: CmsTagDoc
CmsTagDoc.description: Normalized tag reference record stored in /cms_tags/{tagSlug}.

description.description: Semantic meaning of this tag (0 to 400 characters).

usageCount.description: Number of published resources referencing this tag.

CmsResourceRelationshipDoc.title: CmsResourceRelationshipDoc
CmsResourceRelationshipDoc.description: Normalized directed graph relationship between two encyclopedia resources stored in /cms_resource_relationships/{relationshipId}.

notes.description: Optional architectural relationship rationale (0 to 400 characters).

isPublic.description: True when source resource is published.

UserSubmissionDoc.title: UserSubmissionDoc
UserSubmissionDoc.description: Moderated community submission or resource issue report stored in /cms_submissions/{submissionId}. Never executes or publishes automatically.

submitterUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user.

submitterName.description: Display name of the submitting user (1 to 80 characters).

submissionType.description: Classification of user contribution or issue report.

title.description: Submission title or issue summary (3 to 140 characters).

targetResourceSlug.description: Associated resource slug when reporting a correction or adding an example.

summary.description: Detailed explanation of the proposed resource or correction (10 to 3000 characters).

proposedCodeOrContent.description: Untrusted plain-text code snippet or documentation payload inspected during moderation (0 to 15000 characters).

sourceUrl.description: Reference URL or specification link (0 to 500 characters).

licenseAttestation.description: License and attribution attestation provided by submitter (1 to 200 characters).

reviewedByUid.description: UID of the reviewer or admin who processed the submission.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest moderation update.

CmsReviewDoc.title: CmsReviewDoc
CmsReviewDoc.description: Formal editorial review record stored in /cms_reviews/{reviewId} capturing reviewer decision, checklist verification score, and notes.

reviewerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Reviewer/Admin.

checklistPassedCount.description: Number of preview validation checks passed (0 to 7).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was recorded.

CmsStorageAssetDoc.title: CmsStorageAssetDoc
CmsStorageAssetDoc.description: Secure media & storage metadata record stored in /cms_storage_assets/{assetId} enforcing bucket separation, file size, extension, content type, and public/private authorization.

fileName.description: Sanitized file name with validated extension.

sizeBytes.description: Validated file size in bytes (1 to 5242880).

visibility.description: Private files are never exposed publicly without authorization.

CmsAuditLogDoc.title: CmsAuditLogDoc
CmsAuditLogDoc.description: Immutable append-only audit log entry recording administrative actions, workflow transitions, category migrations, and role changes.

actorUid.description: Immutable UID of the authenticated admin/editor/reviewer performing the action.

actorName.description: Display name of the actor (1 to 80 characters).

actorRole.description: Verified role of the actor at the time of action.

action.description: Action identifier (e.g. resource.publish, resource.approve, category.merge, role.assign).

targetType.description: Entity domain affected by the action.

targetId.description: Slug or document ID of the affected entity.

summary.description: Human-readable audit summary of the change (1 to 500 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit event was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and workspace preferences document. Isolated strictly to the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Owner-isolated saved encyclopedia resource bookmarks. Document ID is the resourceSlug to enforce deduplication.

/collections/{collectionId}.description: User-curated resource collections supporting owner CRUD and public/private visibility.

/collections/{collectionId}/items/{itemI.description: Normalized collection items inside a user collection supporting scalable ordered membership.

/experiments/{experimentId}.description: User-saved interactive playground code experiments with bounded source payload sizes and public/private visibility.

/admin_roles/{userId}.description: Server-enforced administrative role assignments (super_admin, admin, editor, reviewer). Writable exclusively by Super Administrators.

/cms_resources/{resourceSlug}.description: Structured CMS encyclopedia resources with 8 field groups, preview validation state, revision tracking, and role-gated editorial workflow.

/cms_categories/{categorySlug}.description: CMS-managed taxonomy categories supporting nested subcategory hierarchies, ordering, featured flags, and safe category merge/reassignment.

/cms_subcategories/{subcategoryId}.description: Normalized hierarchical subcategory records linked to parent categories and optional parent subcategories.

/cms_resource_revisions/{revisionId}.description: Immutable versioned resource revision snapshots tracking schemaVersion and sample-seed vs verified-editorial origin.

/cms_resource_examples/{exampleId}.description: Structured runnable demonstration examples associated with encyclopedia resources.

/cms_implementation_variants/{variantId}.description: Multi-framework and multi-language implementation variants for encyclopedia resources.

/cms_preview_configs/{configId}.description: Normalized sandbox preview configuration and customization parameter schema records.

/cms_tags/{tagSlug}.description: Normalized taxonomy tag dictionary and usage counter records.

/cms_resource_relationships/{relationshi.description: Directed graph relationship edges (related, prerequisite, alternative, extends) between encyclopedia resources.

/cms_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Moderated user resource submissions and issue reports. Defaults to pending_review and never publishes or executes automatically.

/cms_reviews/{reviewId}.description: Formal editorial review decisions and validation gate scores recorded by Reviewers and Administrators.

/cms_storage_assets/{assetId}.description: Secure media and storage asset metadata separating resource-thumbnails, verified-visual-references, user-uploads, and admin-assets.

/cms_audit_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable append-only audit log tracking all CMS editorial transitions, category mutations, submission reviews, and role assignments.
